sourceOccurrences.label: Finite adaptive transcript laws
sourceOccurrences.locator: Named statement start lines in the pinned source: 24, 32, 50, 79, 110, 127
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Source-inspected statement correspondence with scope qualifications
sourceOccurrences.note: QH7Q supplies the arbitrary-index injective sampling law. EE11 gives finite transcript weights and factorization against arbitrary measurable events on the complement. 86IX identifies adaptive answers with their fixed-string cylinder without a no-repeat hypothesis; only the subsequent product formula requires distinct queries along that string. Conditional division in 56TE requires positive transcript probability and is an expository consequence. No independence of the random queried set is inferred. Empty transcripts and distinct loop/non-loop coordinates are included. Infinite explorations and general randomized rules are not established by this source module.
